consumed_runtime.exactness_law: Observable Git/tool/object/lineage coordinates are measurable; hidden activations, private chain-of-thought, physical host topology, and unexposed scheduler internals remain unobservable.
consumed_runtime.return_law: Every coordinate retains native provenance sufficient for reverse navigation or reports RETURN_UNAVAILABLE.

recipient_decision_change.before: Treat the run-local 12D ordinal tuple as the primary coordinate carrier for the experiment.
recipient_decision_change.after: Treat ATHENA.LIMINAL.RUNTIME.v1 as the exact provenance-bearing carrier and retain the run-local 12D tuple only as a compact projection/chart.
recipient_decision_change.reason: The sibling carrier preserves exact HEAD/tree/tool/object/version/return provenance and therefore dominates an ordinal-only chart for replay and reverse navigation.

mapping.Xs: O+V via the versioned run source registry
mapping.Ys: P/semantic registry metadata; no lossless native equivalent
mapping.Zs: P recursion metadata; no lossless native equivalent

chart_bridge.loss: NON_BIJECTIVE_PROJECTION; ordinal registries require explicit identity/version to compare across runs

new_observed_movement.event: overlapping Athena liminal sibling delta detected and consumed

self_play.policy_A: Keep local ordinal 12D chart as primary exact map.
self_play.policy_B: Use provenance-bearing ATHENA.LIMINAL.RUNTIME.v1 as exact carrier; keep 12D chart as a compact projection.
self_play.adversary: Ordinal codes can remain numerically identical while registry meaning or Git object versions change, creating false exactness.
self_play.verifier: Policy B retains native object/version/transport/return coordinates and makes projection loss explicit.

reseed: Independent witness should replay PR #18 using the exact provenance carrier and test whether the compact projection remains stable under changed registry versions and Git ancestry.
